rows.Origin:
Bred by Kikuo Teranishi (Japan, 2004).
Introduced in Japan by Itami Rose Nursery in 2005 as 'Blue Time'.
rows.Bloom: Lilac, pink undertones. Moderate fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dark green foliage.

Height: up to 39" (up to 100cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Source: Website Murata Rose Nursery
